about.intro.p1: Rain Radar shows live rain and lightning across France on a single map — with a two-hour replay and a 90-day archive you can scrub through. No ads, no tracking.
about.stats.heading: Statistics

alert.sheet.title: Storm alerts
alert.sheet.explain: Get notified when lightning strikes within 30 km (storm approaching) or 10 km (storm overhead) of a point you choose.
alert.sheet.disclaimer: Informational only — not a safety warning. Detection is community-based (Blitzortung) and delivery is best-effort.
alert.sheet.status: Alerts are active around the marked point.
alert.place.hint: Position the map on your alert point
alert.notify.outer.title: ⚡ Storm approaching
alert.notify.inner.title: ⚡ Storm overhead
alert.notify.body: Lightning {dist} km {dir} of your alert point
alert.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
alert.out_of_coverage: This point is outside the lightning coverage area.
alert.sheet.push_active: Alerts will also reach this device when the app is closed.
alert.sheet.foreground_only: Alerts fire only while the app is open on this device.
alert.sheet.ios_install: On iPhone/iPad, install the app (Share → Add to Home Screen) to get alerts when it's closed.
alert.sheet.privacy: While push alerts are on, your alert point (rounded to ~1 km) is stored on the server. Turning alerts off deletes it.
